rappel_detail.station: The top of the summit gully on Frenzel Spitz.
rappel_detail.notes: First of two rappels down the summit gully. With a 70 m rope, one rappel reaches; the gully can also be downclimbed at 5.6.

rappel_detail.station: Partway down the summit gully, at the end of the first rappel.
rappel_detail.notes: Second rappel, to the base of the gully.

set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels down the summit gully, or one with a 70 m rope, or a 5.6 downclimb. Parties continuing the full enchainment often use the three-rappel crossover descent toward the Ottohorn instead. Lengths are not published.
set.descent: Rappel or downclimb the summit gully, then scramble back to the Ottohorn-Himmelhorn col.
